label: Quotient flow — builds itself
description: A Quotient flow (automation) diagram in the product's own look -- white step cards with icons, grey curved connectors, green True / red False branch pills, the dotted canvas -- drawn from a list of STEPS and laid out automatically (branches spread side by side, a step with two `after`s merges them). It UNFURLS: row by row, each connector draws in and its step pops, branches together (`pace` seconds per row, or a step's own `at`). Then a SCRIPT performs on it: `highlight` (blue glow + a twinkle of sparkles), `path` (a lit dot runs through a list of steps, lighting each connector and pulsing each step it reaches -- 'this is what happened for Sarah'), `focus` (camera pushes in on a step), `fit` (back out), `card` (the agent's findings: a card opens beside a step, rows landing one by one, the camera framing both), `send` (an envelope lifts off a step and flies out of the flow -- 'right' / 'left' / 'down', or 'camera': at the viewer until it fills the frame, the join into the lead's inbox) and `live` (many leads at once: a dot leaves every `every` seconds along the listed `paths`, each step pings on arrival and counts how many reached it -- the funnel running). Every step card publishes a [data-anchor] named by its id (camera moves and morphs can target 'flow.welcome'). Every `at` takes a word anchor ("@acts"). With no steps it shows a real onboarding flow. Use it full-frame for 'Quotient acts on it' beats: the logic building itself, then one customer's path through it. On a 9x16 frame keep it to 2-3 branches and 4-6 rows, or use camera "follow": UI-size text is small when a wide flow fits a phone.

steps.label: Steps (in order; each follows the previous unless `after` says otherwise)

kind.label: Kind
kind.placeholder: trigger (Programmatic) | event | schedule | person-update | person-created | marketing-event | webhook | crm-record | agent | conditional | email | ai-email | slack | http | notify | update | lead-score | crm | delay | end

after.label: After (step id, or a list of ids to merge)

branch.label: Branch label on the connector in

icon.label: Icon override
icon.placeholder: play | zap | branch | mail | slack | webhook | bell | user | clock | eye | sparkles | trending | briefcase | message | file | target | flag | quotient | database | calendar | globe | video | pointer | inbox

ai.label: AI badge (Quotient mark after the title)

at.label: Appears at (s or @word; default: its row's slot)

unfurl.label: Unfurl (false = the whole flow is already there)

camera.label: Camera
camera.placeholder: fit (whole flow) | follow (rides the unfurl and the path)

action.label: Action
action.placeholder: highlight | path | focus | fit | card | send | live

steps.label: Step ids (path: in order; highlight: several; live: one path when `paths` is not given)

until.label: Highlight / card / live ends at (default: scene end)

side.label: Card: which side of the step (right | left)

focus.label: Card: camera frames the step and the card (default true)

to.label: Send: where the envelope flies (right | left | down | camera)

paths.label: Live: the routes leads take, each a list of step ids, used in turn

counts.label: Live: each step counts its arrivals (default true)

count_from.label: Live: a step's count before the scene (step id -> number); real numbers only

color.label: Path / live dot colour (default the accent)
